paragraphs.en: Tip decided to place Jack at the bend in the road near the house. Dragging him was difficult, but after some effort, he managed to get Jack standing. By bending his legs and pushing from behind, they eventually reached the designated spot.
paragraphs.zh: 提普决定把杰克安置在房子附近道路的拐弯处。拖动他并不容易，但经过一番努力，最终还是让杰克站了起来。通过弯曲双腿并在后面推搡，他们终于来到了指定的位置。

paragraphs.en: The journey was bumpy, but Tip felt proud of his work.
paragraphs.zh: 这段旅程颇为颠簸，但提普为自己所做的一切感到自豪。

paragraphs.en: "Jack's all right, and works fine!" he said, panting from the exertion. He then noticed that Jack’s left arm had fallen off during transport.
paragraphs.zh: “杰克还行，运作正常！”他喘着气说道。随后他发现，在运输过程中，杰克的左臂竟然脱落了。

paragraphs.en: After finding it, Tip whittled a new pin to reattach it, making the arm stronger than before.
paragraphs.zh: 找到那东西后，提普削了一根新针来重新固定，结果手臂比原来更加强壮了。

paragraphs.en: Tip also realized Jack’s pumpkin head was twisted around. With a few adjustments, Jack looked like a realistic Gillikin farmer. However, Mombi returned earlier than expected after trading magical secrets with a wizard in the mountains.
paragraphs.zh: 蒂普也发现杰克的南瓜头扭歪了。经过几处调整后，杰克看起来像一个逼真的吉利金农民。然而，莫比在与山中一位巫师交换魔法秘密之后，比预期更早地返回了。

paragraphs.en: Upon turning the bend, Mombi greeted the figure but noticed it did not respond. Upon closer inspection, she saw the intricately carved pumpkin head and realized Tip’s handiwork.
paragraphs.zh: 转过弯道，蒙比 greet 了那身影，但发现对方并未回应。仔细一看，她看到了那个雕刻精美的南瓜头，意识到这是提普的手笔。

paragraphs.en: Mombi grunted angrily. "That rascally boy has been playing tricks again! Very good!
paragraphs.zh: 莫比米哼了一声，愤怒地说：“那个顽皮的男孩又在搞鬼了！真不赖！”

paragraphs.en: I'll beat him black-and-blue for trying to scare me."
paragraphs.zh: 我可不会让他吓到我，非得把他打得鼻青脸肿不可。

paragraphs.en: She raised her stick to smash the pumpkin head of the dummy but paused, thinking. "Why not try my new powder? Then I can see if that crooked wizard traded fairly or tricked me as I did him."
paragraphs.zh: 她举起木棍准备砸向那个假人的南瓜头，但停了下来，想了想：“不如试试我 newly 配制的粉末？这样我可以看看那名 弹曲 的巫师是公平交易还是像我那样骗了他。”

paragraphs.en: Setting down her basket, she searched for a precious powder. Meanwhile, Tip returned with nuts and noticed Mombi standing beside his man Jack without fear.
paragraphs.zh: 放下篮子后，她开始寻找一种珍贵的粉末。与此同时，蒂普带着坚果回来了，并注意到莫比站在杰克身旁，竟没有一丝惧意。

paragraphs.en: Initially disappointed, Tip hid behind a hedge to watch what Mombi would do. She found an old pepper-box labeled "Powder of Life" and exclaimed, "Ah -- here it is! Let's see if it works."
paragraphs.zh: 起初有些失望，蒂普躲在灌木后观察莫比米会做什么。她发现了一个旧胡椒罐，上面标着“生命粉末”的字样，不禁脱口而出：“啊——就是它！让我们看看是否有效吧。”

paragraphs.en: Tip was surprised when he heard her. Mombi sprinkled the powder over Jack’s head as one would season a baked potato. The powder fell onto his red shirt, pink waistcoat, purple trousers, and even his patched shoes.
paragraphs.zh: 提普听到这话时大吃一惊。蒙比将粉末洒在杰克的头上，就像给烤土豆加调料一样随意。粉末落在了他的红色衬衫、粉红色的背心、紫色的裤子，甚至那双补丁鞋上。

paragraphs.en: Mombi then raised her hands, saying "Weaugh!" with her little finger up, "Teaugh!" with her thumb up, and finally "Peaugh!"
paragraphs.zh: 莫比随后举起双手，食指向上喊道：“韦厄！”拇指向上则叫了一声：“泰厄！”最后则是：“佩厄！”

paragraphs.en: with all fingers spread. Jack stepped back, reproachfully saying, "Don't yell like that! Do you think I'm deaf?"
paragraphs.zh: 张开所有手指。杰克后退一步，抱怨道：“别喊得那么大声！你以为我聋了？”

paragraphs.en: Mombi danced around him, delighted. "He lives!" she screamed, "He lives!
paragraphs.zh: 莫比米跳着他转了个圈，欣喜若狂。“他还活着！”她喊道，“他还活着！”

paragraphs.en: he lives!"
paragraphs.zh: 他活着！

paragraphs.en: Tip watched in amazement as Dorothy repeated, "He lives! -- he lives!" She tossed her stick and hugged herself, attempting a jig.
paragraphs.zh: 蒂普目瞪口呆地望着多萝西反复说道：“他还活着！——他还活着！”她扔掉了手杖，紧紧抱住自己，试着跳起了小舞步。

paragraphs.en: Initially terrified, Tip wanted to flee but his legs trembled too badly. Seeing Jack's pumpkin face come alive was so comical that it made him laugh. Mombi heard the laughter and rushed to grab Tip by the collar.
paragraphs.zh: 起初，提普吓得想要逃跑，但他的双腿颤抖得太厉害。看到杰克那南瓜般扭曲的脸庞突然活了过来，让他忍不住笑了出来。莫比听到了笑声，急忙跑过来抓住了提普的衣领。

paragraphs.en: "You naughty, sneaking boy!" she exclaimed angrily. "I'll teach you to spy on me!"
paragraphs.zh: “你这个狡猾的小子！”她气愤地喊道，“我要让你知道偷窥我是什么滋味！”

paragraphs.en: Tip protested, "I wasn't making fun of you; I was laughing at old Pumpkinhead! Look at him—aren’t his features hilarious?"
paragraphs.zh: 提普抗议道：“我不是在取笑你，我在笑南瓜头呢！你看他——他的五官多滑稽啊！”

paragraphs.en: Jack added, "I hope you're not criticizing my appearance." His serious voice and smiling face made Tip laugh again.
paragraphs.zh: 杰克补充道：“我希望你没在批评我的长相。”他严肃的语气和微笑的脸庞让蒂普再次笑了起来。

paragraphs.en: Mombi, intrigued by the man her magic had brought to life, asked, "What do you know?"
paragraphs.zh: 莫比被她魔法唤醒的男子所吸引，好奇地问道：“你知道些什么？”

paragraphs.en: Jack replied, "It's hard to say. I feel knowledgeable but unsure of how much more there is to learn. It will take time to figure out if I'm wise or foolish."
paragraphs.zh: 杰克回答说：“很难一言以蔽之。我感觉自己学到了不少，但又不确定还能学到多少。要过一段时间才能知道我是明智还是愚蠢。”

paragraphs.en: Mombi pondered, "To be sure."
paragraphs.zh: 莫比姆思量片刻，点了点头，“确实如此。”

paragraphs.en: Tip then asked, "What are you going to do with him now he’s alive?"
paragraphs.zh: 蒂普随后问道：“他现在醒了，你要怎么处置他？”

paragraphs.en: Mombi replied, "I must think about it. But we need to get home; it's getting dark. Help the Pumpkinhead walk."
paragraphs.zh: 莫比回答道：“我得好好考虑一下。不过我们还是赶紧回家吧，天色已经晚了。帮南瓜头走路。”

paragraphs.en: Jack said, "Never mind me—I can walk just fine. I have legs and joints."
paragraphs.zh: 杰克说道：“别为我担心——我走路完全没问题。我有腿和关节。”

paragraphs.en: Mombi led the pumpkin man to the cow stable and locked him in an empty stall. She then instructed Tip to light a candle while she placed her basket in a cupboard and hung her cloak on a peg. Tip quickly complied, fearing Mombi's wrath.
paragraphs.zh: 莫比领着南瓜人来到牛棚，把他关进一个空置的马厩里。随后，她吩咐提普点燃一支蜡烛，自己则把篮子放在柜子里，挂在钉子上挂起了斗篷。提普迅速照办了，生怕惹恼莫比。

paragraphs.en: After lighting the candle, Mombi ordered Tip to build a fire. While he did so, she ate her supper. Once the flames crackled, Tip asked for some bread and cheese but was refused.
paragraphs.zh: 点燃蜡烛后，蒙比命令提普生火。提普动手做这件事的时候，她开始享用晚餐。火焰噼啪作响后，提普请求一些面包和奶酪，但被拒绝了。

paragraphs.en: He grumbled about being hungry, which made him wary of Mombi’s intentions.
paragraphs.zh: 他抱怨饿得难受，这让他对莫比米的意图产生了警惕。

paragraphs.en: Mombi then rose, shook crumbs from her apron, and hung a small black kettle above the fire. She measured equal parts of milk and vinegar into it, adding various herbs and powders. Occasionally, she consulted a yellow paper to read recipes aloud.
paragraphs.zh: 莫比随后站起身，抖了抖围裙上的碎屑，将一个小黑壶悬挂在火炉上方。她将等量的牛奶和醋倒入壶中，又加入各种草药和粉末。偶尔，她会查阅一张黄色的纸条，朗读上面的配方。

paragraphs.en: Tip watched nervously as the mixture began to bubble. He asked what it was for, but Mombi only replied that it was for him. Tip squirmed on his stool, staring at the bubbling kettle and wishing he were anywhere else in that dim kitchen.
paragraphs.zh: 提普紧张地盯着那混合物开始冒泡。他问这是用来做什么的，但莫比只说是为了他自己。提普坐在凳子上扭来扭去，目光紧紧盯着冒着泡的大锅，恨不得自己能出现在厨房里任何一个别的地方。

paragraphs.en: An hour passed with only the pot's bubbling and flames' hissing breaking the silence.
paragraphs.zh: 一小时过去，只有锅的咕嘟声和火焰的嘶嘶声打破了寂静。

paragraphs.en: Finally, Tip asked if he had to drink the mixture. Mombi confirmed that he did, prompting him to inquire about its effects.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，提皮问 whether 他是否必须喝下这种混合物。蒙米确认他确实需要喝，于是提皮便追问起了它的效果。

paragraphs.en: Mombi declared, "If properly made, it will turn you into a marble statue." Tip groaned and wiped his forehead with his sleeve. "I don't want to be a marble statue!"
paragraphs.zh: 莫比尼宣布：“如果制作得当，这粉末会让你变成一座大理石雕像。”提普呻吟了一声，用袖子擦了擦额头。“我不想变成大理石雕像！”

paragraphs.en: he protested.
paragraphs.zh: 他抗议道。

paragraphs.en: The old woman looked at him sternly. "It doesn't matter; I want you to be one." She continued, "What use would you be then?
paragraphs.zh: 老妇人严厉地盯着他说道：“没关系；我就是要你做到这一点。”她继续说，“那你又能有什么用处呢？”

paragraphs.en: There won’t be anyone to work for me."
paragraphs.zh: 不会再有人为我效力了。

paragraphs.en: Mombi suggested, "I'll make the Pumpkinhead work for me." Tip groaned again and asked anxiously, "Why don't you change me into a goat or a chicken? You can't do anything with a marble statue."
paragraphs.zh: 莫比提议道：“我要让南瓜头为我效力。”提普再次发出呻吟，焦虑地问道：“你为什么不把我变成羊或鸡呢？一个大理石雕像你能拿它怎么办？”

paragraphs.en: Mombi replied, "Oh, yes, I can. Next spring, I'm going to plant a flower garden and put you in the middle of it as an ornament. I wonder why I haven’t thought of that before; you've been a bother to me for years."
paragraphs.zh: 莫比回答道：“哦，当然可以。明年春天，我要种一个花圃，把你放在中间作为装饰。我真不知道自己为什么以前没想到这一点；你让我烦了好多年了。”

paragraphs.en: Tip felt beads of perspiration starting all over his body but sat still, shivering and anxiously looking at the kettle. "Perhaps it won't work," he muttered weakly.
paragraphs.zh: 提普全身汗珠oordnate地冒了起来，却一动不动地坐在那里，颤抖着，焦虑地盯着锅子。“或许不会起作用吧，”他无力地说。

paragraphs.en: Mombi answered cheerfully, "I seldom make a mistake." A long, gloomy silence followed until Mombi finally lifted the kettle from the fire, close to midnight. She announced, "You cannot drink it until it has become quite cold.
paragraphs.zh: 莫比愉快地回答：“我很少出错。”随后是一阵漫长的沉默，直到接近午夜时分，莫比才从火堆上端起了水壶。她宣布道：“你们得等到它完全冷却了才能喝。”

paragraphs.en: We must both go to bed now; at daybreak I will call you and complete your transformation into a marble statue."
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在都去睡觉吧；天一亮我就叫你，帮你完成变成大理石雕像的转变。

paragraphs.en: Mombi hobbled into her room with the steaming kettle, closing and locking the door behind her. Tip did not obey his command to go to bed but sat glaring at the embers of the dying fire.
paragraphs.zh: 莫比拖着脚步走进房间，身后留下一壶冒着热气的水，随即关上了门并反锁。蒂普没有听从命令去睡觉，而是坐在那里怒视着即将熄灭的炉火余烬。
